description: This file contains C source code implementing POSIX-compliant date and time parsing functions, including a parser for date strings, along with associated helper functions and a test harness.

methods.name: int year(struct tm * tm,const int * digit_pair,size_t n,unsigned int syntax_bits)
methods.description: Helper function to parse and set the year component in a tm structure based on digit pairs and syntax bits.

methods.name: int posix_time_parse(struct tm * tm,const char * s,unsigned int syntax_bits)
methods.description: Parses a date string into a tm structure based on POSIX format specifications, handling various date formats and syntax bits.

methods.name: bool posixtime(time_t * p,const char * s,unsigned int syntax_bits)
methods.description: Converts a POSIX date string into a time_t value, validating the parsed date and time.
